items.text: Fatou is the world’s oldest gorilla. She lives at the Berlin Zoo and just turned 68 years old. Most gorillas in the wild live only 30 to 40 years, so Fatou is very special. She has lived at the zoo for 66 years after arriving at age two. Fatou is the Western Lowland Gorilla, a kind of gorilla that lives in parts of Africa. These gorillas are in danger because their homes in the wild are disappearing . Fatou has some problems with her arms and legs. She can’t fully straighten them and has a disease in her joints called arthrosis. But she still feels good. She doesn’t have teeth, so she eats soft food like cooked vegetables and fruit. The zoo takes good care of her. Difficult words: disappear (to not exist anymore), straighten (to make or become straight). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Fatou is a gorilla who lives at a zoo in Berlin. She is 68 years old, very old for a gorilla. Most gorillas only live to be 30 or 40. Fatou lives at the zoo for 66 years. She comes when she is just 2 years old. She is from Africa. Her kind is called the Western Lowland Gorilla. Fatou cannot walk very well now. Her legs and arms hurt. She walks a little bent over . She does not have teeth, so she eats soft food. She gets cooked vegetables and some fruit as a treat . The people at the zoo help her and make sure she feels good. Happy birthday, Fatou! Difficult words: zoo (a place where animals live for people to visit), bent over (when your upper body is forward while you are standing or sitting), treat (something special what you get and it makes you happy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Bhalil, a small town in Morocco, is famous for its ancient cave houses. These caves have been home to different cultures since the 4th century, starting with the Amazigh people, followed by the Volubilis and the Banu Hilal. Today, many caves are still used, while some are tourist attractions. Locals like Thami Anjam and Najia Sribet share their caves with tourists, showing the beauty and challenges of living in a rock formation. Humidity is a major issue, but many caves have been modernized with electricity and water. Bhalil’s tourism brings visitors from all over the world, benefiting the local economy. However, modern houses are replacing the caves, threatening their survival. To preserve these historic dwellings , local organizations are seeking government support to restore the caves. Despite the difficulties, the caves remain an important part of Bhalil’s cultural identity, attracting hundreds of tourists annually. Difficult words: humidity (moisture in the air), modernized (made more modern, improved), dwelling (a house or place to live in). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Bhalil is a small town in Morocco, famous for its old cave houses. People lived in the caves since the 4th century. Many of the caves are still in use , while others attract tourists. Thami Anjam opened his cave to tourists, while his neighbor, Najia Sribet, still lives in her cave. There are challenges to living in caves, like dealing with humidity , but some caves have modern things like water and electricity. Bhalil welcomes hundreds of tourists every year, and tourism helps the local economy. But people prefer modern houses now, so they use fewer caves as homes. The local group hopes the government will help repair the caves to protect Bhalil’s history. Difficult words: cave (a large hole in a hill or mountain), in use (when you regularly use something), humidity (how much water is there in the air). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Bhalil is a small town in Morocco. Many people in Bhalil live inside caves . These caves are very old. People live in them for hundreds of years. Some families live in their caves for generations . Living in the caves can be hard. They can get wet . People must clean them often. Some people like Najia Sribet still live in their caves. Others, like Thami Anjam, open their caves for tourists to visit. The caves have lights and water to make them nice for visitors. Bhalil has many tourists, and this helps the town make money. Today, people like modern houses more. Many caves are empty . The people of Bhalil want to repair the caves. They want to save the caves and bring more tourists, too. Difficult words: cave (a large hole in a hill or mountain), generation (different groups of people in a family, like grandparents, parents, and children), empty (without anything or anyone inside). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tourism in Barcelona has caused a significant rise in housing prices. Many locals cannot afford to rent apartments anymore, especially in the city center. The city council wants to stop this problem by banning tourist apartments from 2028. People like Alicia Conejero and Nadia Chaibi Kaddouri are protesting because rents have increased too much. Nadia is a single mother who lost her old apartment because investors wanted to turn it into tourist housing. Now, she lives in a temporary home made from recycled shipping containers. Many landlords prefer to rent to tourists because they can earn much more money. This makes it very hard for local people, especially those with low incomes, to find a place to live. The city has also created cooperative housing projects where people can live without fear of rent increases. Alicia now lives in one of these homes and pays a fair price. Barcelona wants to keep tourism but also protect its residents. The goal is to find a balance that works for everyone. Difficult words: landlord (a person who rents out homes), cooperative housing (a group that owns and manages housing together). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Barcelona, tourism makes housing very expensive. Many people cannot pay for rent anymore. The city wants to stop tourist apartments in 2028. People like Alicia and Nadia say that housing is too costly now. Nadia lost her apartment because the owner wanted to rent it to tourists. She now lives in a small place made from shipping containers . Many landlords rent homes to tourists who pay more money. This is a big problem for people who don’t earn that much money. The city is making special homes where rent doesn’t go up. Alicia lives in one of these homes and is happy to pay less. Barcelona still wants tourists to come. But the city also wants to help local people stay in their homes and live better. Difficult words: costly (expensive), shipping container (a large metal box which people use to store things or to live in), landlord (a person who rents out homes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Barcelona has many tourists. Now homes cost too much. People cannot pay the rent. The city wants to stop some tourist homes in 2028. Alicia and Nadia say that the rent is too high. Nadia loses her home. She now lives in a small box home with her two kids. People who own homes rent to tourists. They get more money from tourists than from residents . It is a problem because poor people cannot find a home. The city is making some new homes. The price is okay here. Alicia lives in one of these homes. Barcelona wants tourists to come. But the city wants to help people who live here. They want homes to be cheap again. Difficult words: rent (money which you pay to live in a home), resident (a person who lives or has their home in a place), poor (when someone does not have much money). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Clune Park, once a busy housing estate in Port Glasgow, is now mostly empty and falling apart. It was built over 100 years ago for shipyard workers, but when shipbuilding declined , people left, and the area became known for vandalism and very low property prices. The estate is often compared to Chernobyl because of its abandoned and eerie appearance. Only a few people still live there, like Marshal Craig, who doesn’t want to move. The area’s decline has been made worse by a long conflict between the local council and private landlords. Many buildings are dangerous, so the council plans to demolish about a third of them, including a damaged school and church. The goal is to build 165 new homes on the site, but progress is slow because many old flats are still privately owned. Locals are sad about losing a part of their history but also hope for a better future. The council wants to create a new neighborhood that serves the community for years to come. Difficult words: decline (to drop or lose quality or activity), vandalism (deliberate destruction or damage to public or private properties), eerie (strange and frightening). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Clune Park is a very old housing area in Port Glasgow, Scotland. Shipyard workers used to live here over 100 years ago, but many people left when jobs ended. Now, most homes are empty and broken. Some flats cost less than 10,000 pounds. The place looks very strange, like the Chernobyl area, so people call it Scotland’s Chernobyl. A few people still live there. One man, Marshal, says he likes it and wants to stay. The local council wants to fix the area, but it is hard because many homes still belong to private owners. The council plans to take down some buildings and build 165 new homes. Some people feel sad because this place has a long history. But they also hope the new homes will help the area. Difficult words: shipyard (a place where workers build ships), fix (to make something work again), private (belonging to individuals, not the government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Clune Park is in Port Glasgow, Scotland. It is very old. Long ago, workers live there. But when jobs end, they leave. Now most homes are empty and broken. Some homes are very cheap. People call Clune Park Scotland’s Chernobyl because it looks scary. Some people still live there. One man is happy and does not want to leave. The city wants to take down old homes and build 165 new ones. The place has a lot of history . Some people feel sad. But many hope new homes will help the area. Difficult words: empty (with nothing inside), take down (to knock down an old building), history (things which happen in the past). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A US biotech company says it has brought back dire wolves, animals that went extinct more than 12,000 years ago. They created three wolf-like creatures using grey wolves and gene editing. The scientists say they changed the DNA of grey wolves to include traits found in ancient dire wolves. The company used cloning to produce the animals and now calls them dire wolves. However, many scientists are not convinced that these animals are truly dire wolves. They explain that real species are more than just DNA. Each species has unique parasites , bacteria, and behaviors that cannot be recreated. One expert says the company only made small changes to modern wolves. These changes don’t bring back an extinct animal but only create a new version of a grey wolf. Some believe the company is using pop culture and exciting language to get attention and increase its value. Experts warn that science cannot fix the damage humans are doing to nature, saying that protecting real ecosystems is more important than rebuilding lost ones. Difficult words: biotech (a type of science that uses living things, like cells or DNA), dire (very serious, bad, or scary), parasite (a small animal or bug that lives on or inside another animal and takes from it). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A science company in the US says it made three dire wolves. These animals died out a long time ago. Scientists used DNA from grey wolves and added parts from old dire wolves. Then, they made baby wolves using this new DNA. The animals are now a few months old. Some scientists say these are not real dire wolves. They say the company only changed grey wolves a little. Real animals also have special bugs inside their bodies and act their way. These things are missing in the new animals. So the scientists don’t agree with the company. The company wants people to talk about their work. It also wants to make more money. But some people say we should protect nature now and not try to bring back animals from the past. Difficult words: dire (very serious or scary), die out (to stop existing completely), add (to put something with something else). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A company in the US makes animals. It says the animals are dire wolves. These wolves die a long time ago. The company uses grey wolves and changes their body to look like dire wolves. Now, the baby animals are 3 to 6 months old. Some people say that they are not real dire wolves. They say real dire wolves are very special. They live with special bugs and eat special food. These new animals do not have that. They only look like dire wolves. The company wants people to look at their work. But many people say this is not good. They say we must help animals and trees now. We must not make new animals like this. Difficult words: dire (very bad or scary), bug (a small animal, like a fly or beetle). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Crocs became popular in the early 2000s but lost attention after the Great Recession. The company struggled for years; however, things started to change when it focused on personalization through charms called Jibbitz. These small accessories became a big success, helping the brand grow again. By 2024, Crocs had sales of over 4 billion dollars, including their second brand, Hey Dude. The company also gained attention with clever marketing, celebrity partnerships, and creative product designs. Another reason for the brand’s comeback was its new strategy of limited releases and collaborations with famous names. This helped Crocs stay exciting and fashionable. The CEO also helped bring focus back to the classic clog , which became a symbol of self-expression. The pandemic boosted sales as more people wanted comfortable footwear. Despite the success, Crocs faces challenges. Tariffs on Vietnamese imports could increase costs. Also, the Hey Dude brand caused legal trouble, and sales dropped. Still, Crocs hopes to grow globally, especially in Asia, by staying trendy and reaching more customers. Difficult words: personalization (making something special for each person), limited release (when a company makes only a small number of a product to make people want it more), clog (a type of shoe that is easy to wear and often has a thick sole). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Crocs were very popular in the 2000s, but then people stopped buying them. The company made changes and started selling Jibbitz, small charms for Crocs shoes. These helped bring Crocs back. In 2024, Crocs and its second brand, Hey Dude, made over 4 billion dollars. They worked with famous people and made special shoes to keep customers interested. Crocs made shoes that were fun and easy to change. People liked to show their style with them. The company also sold limited edition shoes that were very popular. Crocs became cool again, especially during the pandemic when people wanted comfy shoes. Now, the company has some problems. It may need to pay more to bring shoes from Vietnam. Also, Hey Dude caused problems with some investors and the law. But Crocs wants to grow in other countries and sell more shoes. Difficult words: charm (a small thing for decoration), limited edition (when a company makes a small amount of product or only for a short time), comfy (comfortable, easy to wear or use). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Crocs are shoes. They are cool many years ago. Then, people stop liking them. Crocs must change. They make charms called Jibbitz. You can put them on the shoes. People like that. Crocs sold a lot of shoes again in 2024. Crocs makes new shoe styles. They work with singers and stars. They sell special shoes. People like them again. During the pandemic, people want soft shoes at home. Now, Crocs has some problems. They bring many shoes from Vietnam. A new rule may make this more expensive. Crocs also has problems with Hey Dude shoes. But they want to sell more shoes in many places in the world. Difficult words: cool (trendy, popular), charm (a small thing for decoration), soft (not hard). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Tulum, Mexico, became popular with digital nomads during the pandemic. Its beautiful beaches and relaxed lifestyle led to a big real estate boom. Many people hoped to buy condos and live or invest in paradise. However, some buyers now say they were tricked . Developers promised finished homes but often only cleared land or built half-finished buildings. In some cases, buyers paid up to 90% of the price and ended up with nothing. One developer, Akela Development Group, was behind several projects. Out of six promised buildings, only one was finished. Some of the developers disappeared, one was found dead, and another took his own life. Many buyers lost their savings. Some tried to take legal action, but it has been hard. Local laws are confusing, and some land may not have been legally owned by the sellers. Although people still dream of living in Tulum, many now only buy fully built homes. Difficult words: digital nomad (a person who works online while traveling or living in different places), condo (a type of housing where you own an apartment but share things like pools, gyms, etc.), tricked (fooled, deceived). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Tulum in Mexico became very popular during the pandemic. Many people wanted to live or work there because of the nice beaches and relaxed life. A lot of new apartments were for sale, but many buyers now say they lost their money. Some developers promised to build homes but never finished them. One developer started six projects but finished only one. Some buyers paid almost all the money and got nothing. One developer died, and others ran away. Some people tried to go to court, but it was hard to get help because of Mexican law . In some cases, the sellers didn’t own the land. Now, many people say they will only buy homes that are already finished. Difficult words: developer (a company which creates or builds things), project (a planned task), law (rules of a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people want to live in Tulum, Mexico, during the pandemic. It is a beach town with sun and music. Some people buy homes there. They spend a lot of money. But companies do not build or finish the homes. One company wants to build six buildings, but finishes only one. One man from the company dies. Other people run away. The buyers lose their money. Some people go to police. It does not help. Law in Mexico is difficult. The companies do not always own the land. But they still sell it. Now, people are more careful . They want to buy only finished homes. Difficult words: buyer (a person who buys something), law (rules of a country), careful (when you think a lot before you do something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Grace Davidson is the first woman in the UK to give birth after a womb transplant . She was born with a rare condition where the womb is missing or doesn’t develop fully, so she couldn’t have children. In February 2023, doctors performed a womb transplant operation that changed her life. Her sister Amy, who already had two children, donated her womb for the transplant. Grace later gave birth to a baby girl and named her after Amy to honor her sister’s gift. This act of kindness deeply moved Grace, who felt broken before the operation. She said her quality of life had been poor because of the sadness she felt over not being able to have children. But that sadness disappeared when her baby was born. She now feels joy and fulfillment . The baby’s father said it was an easy decision to support the transplant. He feels thankful every day and says they will never forget the role Amy played in making their family possible. Difficult words: womb (a part of the body where a baby grows), transplant (a medical operation to put an organ into another person), fulfillment (a feeling of happiness and satisfaction). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Grace Davidson couldn’t have a baby because she had a health problem. She was born without a womb or with one that didn’t grow well. Everything changed in 2023 when Grace’s sister Amy gave her a womb. Amy already had two children and decided to donate her womb to her sister. After the transplant , Grace had a baby girl and named her after her sister. Grace said the gift from her sister changed her life. Before the baby came, she felt sad and empty. She said that she feels very happy because she can be a mother. The baby’s father said it was easy to say yes to the idea. He said they will never forget what Amy did for them. Thanks to her, Grace and Angus now have a family and feel very lucky. Difficult words: womb (a part of the body where a baby grows), donate (to let doctors give your blood or an organ to somebody else), transplant (a medical operation to put an organ into another person). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Grace Davidson cannot have a baby. She has no womb. A womb is an organ where the baby grows. A woman cannot have a baby when she has no womb. Grace’s sister Amy gives Grace her womb. She already has two children. She does not want more children. She wants to help her sister. In 2023, doctors do an operation . They transplant Amy’s womb and give it to Grace. After some time, Grace has a baby. She calls the baby her sister’s name. Grace feels very sad before. She wants a baby. Now she feels happy. The baby makes her smile. She is happy to be a mother. The baby’s father is happy, too. He loves the baby. He loves what Grace’s sister does for them. They are a happy family now. Difficult words: operation (when doctors fix or change something in the body), transplant (to put an organ into another person). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Music streaming platform Spotify paid 59 million dollars in royalties to artists from Nigeria and South Africa in 2024. This amount is much higher than in previous years and reflects the growing popularity of African music around the world. African artists like Tyla from South Africa and Burna Boy from Nigeria have become internationally recognized , which has helped to boost interest in their music. In 2024, Nigerian artists earned over 37.8 million dollars, and South African artists earned 21 million dollars. These payments are mainly coming from international listeners, who have been increasingly enjoying music from these countries. The success of these artists has encouraged more mid-level musicians to make a living from their music, creating new opportunities in Africa’s music industry. The increase in royalties is a sign that African music is becoming a powerful force on the global stage. Difficult words: royalty (money paid for the use of something), recognized (being known or identified because of something special you have done), boost (to increase or improve). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Spotify paid 59 million dollars to artists from Nigeria and South Africa in 2024. This is much more than before. The growth of African music made this possible. Big African stars like Burna Boy and Tyla helped bring attention to their music worldwide. Nigerian artists earned almost 38 million dollars, and South African artists earned 21 million dollars. A lot of this money came from fans outside Africa. The success of these artists helped other African musicians make money from their music. More and more musicians are getting the chance to earn a living through their work. African music is becoming more popular, which is good for the music industry. Difficult words: growth (when something grows), attention (focusing on something), earn a living (to make enough money to pay for things like food and housing). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Spotify gives money to artists from Nigeria and South Africa. In 2024, they get 59 million dollars. This is a lot more money than before. Many people like African music now. Stars like Burna Boy from Nigeria and Tyla from South Africa make their music famous . Nigerian artists earn almost 38 million dollars, and South African artists earn 21 million dollars. Most of the money comes from fans outside Africa. This is a good thing for their music. More African musicians now make money from their music. They have enough money to buy things which they need. Difficult words: famous (when many people know someone or something), earn (to make money), fan (a person who likes and enjoys something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Broadway play Good Night, and Good Luck has broken a box office record, earning over 3.3 million dollars in just one week. The show stars Hollywood actor George Clooney, who appears on Broadway for the first time. It is based on the 2005 film he co-wrote and tells the true story of journalist Edward R. Murrow and his battle with Senator Joseph McCarthy in the 1950s. The drama highlights Murrow’s role in exposing McCarthy’s aggressive accusations during the Red Scare. At that time, McCarthy claimed that communists had secretly entered American institutions like the government, universities, and the media. Murrow’s strong journalism helped reveal that many of these accusations were false and unfair, showing McCarthy as a bully. The show also connects to modern times, underlining the role of journalism in protecting democracy. In a time of political division and mistrust of the media, it reminds us how important it is to speak the truth and hold those in power accountable . Difficult words: box office (the amount of money the show or movie earns from ticket sales), expose (to show the truth about something), accusation (a claim or statement that someone has done something wrong or illegal), accountable (responsible for actions or decisions). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Broadway show Good Night, and Good Luck made over 3.3 million dollars in one week. It stars George Clooney, a famous actor, and it is his first time acting on Broadway. The story is about a journalist named Edward R. Murrow. He spoke out against a US senator named Joseph McCarthy in the 1950s. McCarthy said many people were communists, but he didn’t have real proof . Murrow used TV news to show that these people were not guilty . He showed the public that McCarthy was unfair and mean. The play is based on a movie from 2005. It also talks about today’s world, where the media and politics are sometimes in conflict. It reminds people how important it is to tell the truth and protect freedom. Difficult words: proof (facts which show that something is true), guilty (when someone did something wrong or illegal and is responsible for it), based on (when a story or idea uses something else as its main idea). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The show Good Night, and Good Luck is on Broadway . It makes a lot of money in one week. A famous actor, George Clooney, is in the show. It is his first time on Broadway. The show is about a man on TV. His name is Edward R. Murrow. He does not like what a US senator named McCarthy says. It happens in the 1950s. McCarthy says that many people are bad, but it is not true. The show says that it is good to tell the truth . It shows how TV news can help people. The story is from many years ago, but it is still important today. People still talk about the truth and the news. Difficult words: Broadway (a famous place in New York for theater shows), truth (what is real or right), important (something people should care about). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Austria has closed 24 small border crossings with Hungary and Slovakia to stop foot-and-mouth disease from spreading into the country. This decision came after both neighboring countries reported outbreaks . Slovakia declared an emergency after detecting the disease on three farms, and Hungary confirmed its first outbreak in 50 years. In response, Hungary sent soldiers and began disinfecting the affected areas near the Austrian and Slovak borders. Foot-and-mouth disease is very infectious and affects cloven-hoofed animals like cattle, pigs, sheep, and goats. It doesn’t harm humans but causes fever and painful mouth blisters in animals. Such outbreaks often lead to serious economic problems due to trade restrictions and the need to kill infected livestock. Austria has tightened health checks at the few border crossings that remain open. All vehicles and pedestrians must pass over disinfecting rugs. Police are also checking for meat products. Authorities say they are focusing all their resources on controlling the situation and preparing plans if the virus reaches Austrian farms. Difficult words: outbreak (the sudden start of a disease), disinfect (to clean something to kill germs or viruses), cloven-hoofed (an animal that has feet divided into two parts). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Austria closed 24 small border crossings with Hungary and Slovakia to stop foot-and-mouth disease from entering the country. Slovakia found the disease on three farms and said it is an emergency . Hungary also found the disease and sent soldiers to clean the area near the border. The disease doesn’t hurt people but makes animals like cows, pigs, and sheep sick. The animals get fever and painful spots in their mouths. If many animals are sick, countries often stop trade and kill the sick animals to stop the disease. Austria now checks people and cars at open border crossings. People must walk or drive over a special rug that stops the virus. Police also look for meat in cars. Austria says it is ready in case the disease comes into the country. Difficult words: enter (to get into a place), emergency (a serious and dangerous situation), rug (a flat, thin piece of cloth on the ground to clean shoes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Austria closes 24 small roads at the border with Hungary and Slovakia. Bad animal sickness called foot-and-mouth is in those countries. Austria wants to stop it. Slovakia finds sick animals on three farms. Hungary finds the disease, too. Soldiers help farmers clean the area. The sickness does not hurt people. But it makes cows, pigs, and sheep very sick. The animals get fever and pain in the mouth. Farmers cannot sell sick animals. They must kill them. At a few open roads, Austria checks people and cars. They must go over a rug to clean their shoes or tires. Police also look for meat. Austria wants to stop the sickness from coming in. Difficult words: sickness (when a person or animal is not healthy), fever (when your body becomes hotter than normal), rug (a flat thing on the ground to clean shoes). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people across the United States protested against President Trump after he began his second term. These protests happened on the same day the president’s new tariffs were introduced. The tariffs affect imports from many countries and are changing how economies function. Elon Musk discussed a future free trade deal between the US and the European Union. However, the EU now faces a 20% tax on all goods sent to the US. Some world leaders, like those of the UK and France, are planning how to respond together. Australia, also affected by the tariffs, decided not to respond with its taxes. Experts say this is a smart move, as reacting could create more problems. Instead, Australia is focusing on building stronger and more flexible trade strategies . This is important because of the country’s trade ties with both the US and China. Business owners in the US are already seeing the impact. Prices for goods like Scottish whisky and salmon may rise, making it harder to sell them to American customers. Difficult words: tariff (a tax on goods from another country), trade strategy (an established method of planning and making trades that you can follow hoping to make a profit). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many people protested in the US after President Trump started his second term . They were unhappy about his new tariffs . These taxes are for goods from other countries. Elon Musk said he wants the US and EU to have free trade in the future. Right now, the EU must pay a 20% tax on products sent to the US. Some countries, for example, the UK and France, are working together on what to do. Australia also has tariffs now, but will not add their own. The Australian Prime Minister said more taxes would only hurt them. Instead, they want to improve their trade plans. They are trying to keep good relationships with both the US and China. In New York, business owners are worried. Goods from Scotland, like whisky and salmon, will cost more. They are not sure if Americans will keep buying them. Difficult words: term (a period a leader stays in power), tariff (a tax on things from another country), free trade (buying and selling things between countries without limits). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Many people in the US do not like President Trump’s new idea. They walk in the streets and carry signs. They are angry about the new tax . This tax makes it more expensive for other countries to sell things in the US. It is called a tariff. Elon Musk says that the US and Europe should have free trade in the future. Australia also has to pay this tax. But the Prime Minister says Australia will not make a new tax. They want to keep good friends with both the US and China. It is not easy. In New York, people sell food and drink from Scotland. But now the price is going up. Some people say they will buy less. Business owners are worried. Difficult words: tax (money which people or companies must pay to the government), free trade (when countries sell things to each other without paying extra money), owner (a person who has something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Actor Val Kilmer, known for starring in major films like Top Gun and Batman Forever, has died at the age of 65. His daughter Mercedes confirmed that he passed away in Los Angeles due to pneumonia . Kilmer was diagnosed with throat cancer in 2014 but later recovered. During his career, he played several memorable roles, including Jim Morrison in The Doors, Doc Holliday in Tombstone, and a criminal in Heat. His performances were highly praised, and he was considered one of the most talented actors of his generation. Despite his skills, his career slowed down due to a reputation for being difficult to work with. In 2022, he made a comeback in Top Gun: Maverick, reprising his role as Iceman. His character had the same illness he had in real life, making the performance especially emotional. Fans and colleagues remember his legacy and contribution to cinema. Difficult words: pneumonia (a serious lung illness), reputation (what people think about someone, based on their actions or behavior), legacy (the things a person leaves behind after they die, like their work, ideas, or influence), reprising (playing the same role or doing the same job again, especially in movies or theater). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Val Kilmer, a famous actor from Top Gun and Batman Forever, died at 65. His daughter said he had pneumonia and died in Los Angeles. In 2014, Kilmer had throat cancer but got better after treatment . Kilmer acted in many popular movies, and people loved him for his strong performances . He played Jim Morrison in The Doors, a cowboy in Tombstone, and a criminal in Heat. Many people liked his acting, but some directors thought he was hard to work with. Because of this, he got fewer roles in Hollywood. In 2022, he returned in Top Gun: Maverick, playing Iceman again. His character had the same illness he had in real life, which made the scene very emotional . Many people are sad about his death and remember his great movies, which will continue to be loved for years. The European Union is moving towards changing the rules for New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) in agriculture. These techniques modify a plant’s genes rather than adding genes from other species, like traditional GMOs. Supporters argue that these techniques can make plants more resistant to drought and pests while reducing the need for fertilizers . However, some scientists and environmentalists worry that these changes could have unforeseen effects on the environment and human health. There is also disagreement about how to control these new plants. The European Parliament and the European Council have different views on issues such as labeling and patents. The Council has allowed patents under specific conditions, but the Parliament wants a complete ban. They fear monopolies by large agricultural companies will limit farmers’ choices. In many European countries, there has been strong resistance to GM crops, but new laws might remove the right of governments to ban them. Some experts warn that altering plant genetics could have unpredictable effects on biodiversity . Meanwhile, researchers are already exploring the role of artificial intelligence in advancing these technologies, raising even more ethical and scientific concerns. Difficult words: fertilizer (a chemical or natural substance added to soil or land to increase its fertility), unforeseen (not expected or predicted), alter (to change), biodiversity (the variety of plant and animal life in an area). Richard Chamberlain, a famous actor, passed away at the age of 90 due to complications from a stroke. He was well-known for his role in the 1960s television series Dr. Kildare, which made him a household name . His career spanned over 60 years, during which he won three Golden Globe awards and received four Emmy nominations. He became particularly famous in the 1970s and 1980s for starring in many successful television mini-series, including Shogun and The Thorn Birds, which cemented his status as a TV icon. Apart from acting in television and film, Chamberlain was also a respected stage actor. He performed in Broadway productions and was praised for his work in theater. In 2003, Chamberlain published his memoir Shattered Love, in which he openly spoke about his life and revealed that he was gay. His decision to share his truth was an essential step in his journey, and he later embraced roles that reflected his identity. Following his passing, many tributes have been shared by fans and fellow actors. William Shatner called him a talented and dedicated performer. His lifelong partner expressed his sadness, saying that Chamberlain was now with the angels. Despite Chamberlain’s claim that he was not concerned about being remembered, his influence on television, film, and theater will continue. Difficult words: household name (a person or thing that is well known by the public), cement (to make something stronger or more certain), dedicated (believing that something is very important and giving a lot of time and energy to it). Marine Le Pen, the leader of France’s far-right party National Rally, has been found guilty of misusing European Union (EU) funds. As a result, she cannot run for public office for five years, which means she will not be able to participate in the 2027 presidential election. Le Pen also received a four-year prison sentence, with two years suspended and two to be served under house arrest . The court ruled that she and her party illegally used 3 million euros from the EU, which was meant for parliamentary assistants but was instead used to pay party staff in France. This verdict is a serious problem for Le Pen and her party. She was leading in opinion polls for the next election, and her absence creates uncertainty for the National Rally. The party now needs to find another strong candidate. Jordan Bardella, the current party president, is a possible replacement, but some doubt his ability to compete at the highest level of politics. The case has also raised concerns in the European Union, as similar financial scandals have happened before. EU officials are worried about how these misuses of funds affect trust in European institutions. Other politicians, including former UK politician Nigel Farage, have also faced accusations of misusing EU money. Investigations have shown that many members of the European Parliament have had to return the money they took unfairly. Difficult words: misuse (to use something in the wrong way or purpose), house arrest (being kept as a prisoner in one’s own house rather than in a prison), scandal (an action or event that causes a public feeling of shock and strong moral disapproval). TikTok recently removed a filter that used AI to make people appear chubbier after criticism for promoting body shaming . The filter allowed users to see themselves looking heavier, while a similar filter made people appear thinner. This led to videos with captions promoting weight loss and gym culture. Critics argue that these filters feed into young people’s obsession with body image and unrealistic beauty standards. Although the chubby filter has been deleted, the skinny filter remains. TikTok has been criticized for not doing enough to tackle content promoting unhealthy weight loss. The trend of skinny talk encourages extreme weight loss and disordered eating, which some say is harmful to viewers. TikTok states they have taken steps to remove harmful content, but experts suggest more work is needed. Social media platforms like TikTok have a strong influence on how people perceive beauty, and the constant bombardment of these standards affects young users, often causing anxiety about their appearance. Difficult words: chubby (slightly overweight), body shaming (criticizing or mocking someone’s body type), obsession (the control of your thoughts by still the same idea, image, or feeling), bombardment (a continuous attack or overwhelming of something). The Bruce Highway in Queensland is considered dangerous due to its poor condition, especially in rural areas. Many sections of the road remain undivided, which has caused numerous head-on collisions. More than 50% of the 149 fatalities from 2018 to 2022 were due to this type of accident. Families who have lost loved ones are pushing for urgent safety improvements. Betty Stuart, whose husband died in a triple fatal crash, believes these upgrades will prevent further tragedies. The Queensland government has announced a plan to invest in the highway, but the transport industry and the Royal Automobile Club of Queensland (RACQ) say that current measures are insufficient. Truck drivers frequently use this road and claim it is the worst national highway they have experienced. Residents and experts are advocating for the immediate introduction of dual carriageways and wider lanes to reduce the risk of accidents, calling it a death trap that requires action before more lives are lost. Difficult words: head-on collision (an accident that happens when the front parts of two vehicles hit each other directly and with force), fatality (death), dual carriageway (a road that has an area of land in the middle). Millions of waste tires from the UK are sent to India, but instead of being recycled, many end up in illegal pyrolysis plants. This process heats tires to extract oil and steel, releasing toxic chemicals into the air. The BBC found that about half of the UK’s waste tires enter India’s black market , where they are burned in unregulated facilities. Despite strict UK regulations, weak enforcement allows this harmful trade to continue. In one case, a plant near Mumbai exploded, killing four people, including two children. Locals suffer from pollution-related health problems, as soot and chemicals contaminate their environment. Though some factories have been shut down, many still operate. Environmental groups call for stricter controls on tire exports, but businesses claim they cannot control what happens once tires reach India. Activists argue that the UK government must take responsibility and stop this dangerous trade. Difficult words: black market (an illegal place where things are bought and sold), unregulated (not controlled or checked by rules or laws), soot (a black powdery substance that comes from burning things). A swan flying over a lake had a terrible accident when a branch blocked its way. Its head got stuck between two branches, leaving its body hanging in the air. The swan’s neck was squeezed tightly, and it struggled desperately , but the more it fought, the worse it became. Its breathing became quick, and its frightened eyes showed fear. People walking nearby were heartbroken by its painful cries and quickly called a rescue team. A few minutes later, the team arrived with special equipment. A rescuer carefully held the swan’s body to relieve pressure on its neck while breaking the branch to free it. The injured bird was then taken to a veterinary hospital. Though no bones were broken, its wings were torn, and its legs were hurt. The rescue center cared for the swan, giving it a warm and safe place with food. At first, the swan was timid and afraid, but over time, it became stronger and more confident. After two months of recovery, the team released it back into the lake. The other swans quickly recognized it, and they swam together again. The rescuers felt emotional as they watched the swan return to its home, knowing they had saved its life. Difficult words: desperately (in a way that shows worry or sadness), timid (shy or afraid). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Dalí Museum in St. Petersburg, Florida, houses over 2,400 works by the Spanish surrealist Salvador Dalí, including paintings, prints, and sculptures. Dalí, known for his eccentric personality, once claimed he would never die. While he passed away in 1989, his influence lives on. The museum offers immersive experiences like Dalí Alive 360, which showcases his artistic evolution. Dalí’s work blends reality with surrealism, influenced by his classical training and fascination with Sigmund Freud’s psychoanalysis. His famous melting clocks painting is in New York, but many other masterpieces are in Florida, thanks to collectors Elanor and Reynolds Morse, who spent decades acquiring his works. In 1982, they donated their collection, and St. Petersburg offered to house it. The museum, now a major cultural site, attracts over 300,000 visitors yearly. Dalí’s ability to challenge perception continues to inspire, and his surrealist vision remains relevant in today’s world. Difficult words: eccentric (unusual and different), immersive (deeply engaging), acquire (to buy or get), perception (the way we see or understand something).
